note: Who is behind Direct Bullion. Direct Bullion is the trading name of DB London Ltd (09975794), a gold and silver dealer set up in January 2016. Its registered office, Level 1, Devonshire House, Mayfair Place, London W1J 8AJ, is the address on Nigel Farage's register entry. Its only current director is Paul Alan Withers (since April 2018). Since 4 April 2025 DB London has been owned (75% or more) by Eleven Intl Ltd (11808001) of 555-557 Cranbrook Road, Ilford, which is itself owned (75% or more) by Paul Alan Withers. On the same day co-owner Sonny Dobran ceased as a person with significant control of both companies and resigned as a DB London director. Farage is a paid Brand Ambassador.
